narrative.overview: A calm, rigorous, trustworthy product workspace where writers inspect owner-authored material, analysis, evidence, provenance, and review state without mistaking automated output for truth. Visual language and product semantics remain application-owned.
keyCharacteristics: Radix only for bounded complex interaction behavior
Flat-by-default surfaces with limited structural elevation

rules.name: The Truthful Affordance Rule
rules.body: Blocked, unavailable, degraded, review-only, and not-yet-implemented states remain visibly distinct and never masquerade as working actions.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Evidence and provenance precede confidence; confidence communicates support strength, never truth.

rules.name: The Native-First Rule
rules.body: Use native HTML whenever it provides sufficient semantics and behavior; runtime primitives require a bounded complex-interaction need.

dos: Do preserve truthful affordances and explicit owner authority.
Do preserve evidence, provenance, candidate, approval, approved Memory, and Canon distinctions.
Do keep analysis output candidate-first and non-canon.
donts: Don't automatically promote or apply promotion.
Don't automatically mutate approved Memory or Canon.
Don't make blocked or review-only behavior appear actionable.

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--wa-space-12); color: var(--wa-color-surface); background: var(--wa-color-accent); border: 1px solid var(--wa-color-accent); border-radius: var(--wa-radius-control); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--wa-focus-ring); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Existing neutral outlined secondary action treatment.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--wa-space-12); color: var(--wa-color-accent); background: var(--wa-color-surface); border: 1px solid #aab8ce; border-radius: var(--wa-radius-control); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--wa-focus-ring); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Existing application input treatment and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--wa-space-6); color: var(--wa-color-text-secondary); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--wa-font-ui); } .ds-input { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 var(--wa-space-10); color: var(--wa-color-text); background: var(--wa-color-surface-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--wa-color-border); border-radius: var(--wa-radius-surface); font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--wa-color-focus); box-shadow: var(--wa-focus-ring); outline: none; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Existing bordered primary surface without decorative elevation.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: var(--wa-space-20); color: var(--wa-color-text); background: var(--wa-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--wa-color-border); border-radius: var(--wa-radius-surface); font-family: var(--wa-font-ui); } .ds-panel p { color: var(--wa-color-text-secondary); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px var(--wa-space-8); color: var(--wa-color-accent); background: var(--wa-color-surface-selected); border: 1px solid #bdd0f2; border-radius: var(--wa-radius-pill); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--wa-font-ui); }

components.name: Boundary Notice
components.description: Existing evidence, provenance, and review-only boundary treatment.
components.html: <aside class="ds-boundary">Evidence supports review. It is not Canon.</aside>
components.css: .ds-boundary { padding: var(--wa-space-10) var(--wa-space-12); color: var(--wa-color-text-secondary); background: var(--wa-color-surface-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--wa-color-boundary-border); border-radius: var(--wa-radius-surface); font: 400 13px/1.45 var(--wa-font-ui); }

components.name: Radix Evidence Dialog
components.description: Application-owned evidence drawer using Radix Dialog for complex interaction behavior only.
components.html:
Evidence scope

Stored evidence and provenance.
components.css: .ds-evidence-dialog { width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 48px)); padding: 18px; color: var(--wa-color-text); background: var(--wa-color-surface); border-left: 1px solid var(--wa-color-boundary-border); box-shadow: -18px 0 50px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18); font-family: var(--wa-font-ui); } .ds-evidence-dialog:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--wa-focus-ring); }
